ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Kitab Maknun' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase highlights the divine preservation of the Quran and cosmic decrees within the 'Invisible Book,' often linked to the Prophet's household (Ahl al-Bayt) as the living embodiment of divine knowledge. It underscores the concept of 'Ilm al-Ghayb' (Knowledge of the Unseen) residing with Allah, affirming the certainty of resurrection and the immutable nature of divine will.
